Unlike traditional saunas, infrared saunas use light to heat your body directly, warming you from the inside out without making the air unbearably hot. Infrared heat increases blood flow, reducing inflammation and promoting faster muscle recovery-perfect after an intense workout or whenever you're feeling sore.
